features.title: Tool outcome envelope
features.blurb: Every tool returns one compact envelope: result, one error, one correction, a receipt.

steps.title: Solve with no geometry — the envelope carries one error and one concrete correction.
steps.prompt: Run an FEA solve without creating any geometry first.
talking_points: One error, one correction — no traceback soup in LLM context.
The correction names the next tool to call.

steps.title: Call an unknown tool — the router refuses it by name.
steps.prompt: Execute tool nonexistent_cad_generator.
talking_points: Unknown tools are refused before dispatch.
The refusal lists what is available.

steps.title: Invalid dimension — validation keeps the accepted revision intact.
steps.prompt: Create a cantilever beam with length -50 mm.
talking_points: Rejected args never mutate state.

features.title: Pre-mesh B-Rep validation gate
features.blurb: Geometry is validated watertight before any meshing attempt.

steps.title: Strut radius larger than the cell radius — self-intersecting solid rejected pre-mesh.
steps.prompt: Create an X-truss pedal with strut radius 8 mm.
talking_points: The gate rejects before FreeCAD ever meshes.

steps.title: Zero-volume cantilever — degenerate solid rejected.
steps.prompt: Create a cantilever beam with height 0.
talking_points: Degenerate geometry never reaches the solver.

features.title: Design program layer
features.blurb: The design program is the source of truth: persisted params, revision hash, transactional edits.

steps.title: Dry-run preview — proposed change without touching disk.
steps.prompt: Preview changing the pedal cell size to 12 mm without applying it.
talking_points: Dry runs never bump the revision.

steps.title: No-op update — same params, no new revision.
steps.prompt: Change the pedal cell size to 12 mm again.
talking_points: changed: false keeps rev history honest.

steps.title: Applied edit — revision bumps, hash changes.
steps.prompt: Change the pedal cell size to 12 mm and re-solve.
talking_points: Failed rebuilds never clobber the accepted revision.

features.title: Run history + query_results
features.blurb: Every solve appends a run record with run_id; the agent can query history.

steps.title: List recent runs from disk.
steps.prompt: List all simulation runs.
talking_points: Run records persist across restarts.
run_id is sortable and unique.

steps.title: Locate the peak stress of the latest run.
steps.prompt: Where is the peak stress in the latest run located?
talking_points: Spatial results are queryable by run.

features.title: Pre-flight analytical estimates
features.blurb: Before solving, the agent estimates the answer analytically and compares afterwards.

steps.title: Estimate pedal stress by beam envelope.
steps.prompt: Give me a pre-flight analytical estimate for a brake pedal under 500 N.
talking_points: The estimate sets the expected range before compute.

steps.title: Compare FEA vs beam theory on the benchmark.
steps.prompt: Compare the FEA stress to the beam theory value for the cantilever.
talking_points: expected_vs_actual rides on every solve record.

features.title: Mesh convergence study
features.blurb: run_convergence_study re-meshes and re-solves until the KPIs settle.

steps.title: Run the convergence sweep on the cantilever.
steps.prompt: Is the current mesh converged? Run a mesh convergence study on the cantilever.
talking_points: Each step is a real re-solve, not an interpolation.

steps.title: Explain the deflection trend.
steps.prompt: How does tip deflection change across the mesh steps?
talking_points: Convergence claims cite the asymptotic delta.

features.title: Material as parameter
features.blurb: Materials are program parameters with cited properties and physics scaling.

steps.title: Compare Ti vs Al on the current part.
steps.prompt: Compare titanium vs aluminum 6061-T6 for the current part.
talking_points: Scaling derives from one base solve plus cited properties.

steps.title: Switch to PA12 and watch deflection caveats.
steps.prompt: Switch the pedal to PA12 nylon and re-solve.
talking_points: Polymer deflection is flagged NOT VERIFIED.

steps.title: Unknown material — named guardrail.
steps.prompt: Switch the pedal to vibranium.
talking_points: Validation names every valid id.

features.title: Hybrid retrieval + RAG Lab
features.blurb: BM25 + TF-IDF hybrid retrieval with grounding labels and an inspection lab.

steps.title: Ask a grounded materials question.
steps.prompt: What yield strength should I assume for aluminum 6061-T6?
talking_points: Answers cite the corpus source.

steps.title: Ask something outside the corpus.
steps.prompt: What is the tensile strength of unobtainium?
talking_points: No-match grounding refuses to invent numbers.

steps.title: Open the RAG Lab to inspect retrieval.
steps.prompt: Open the RAG Lab.
talking_points: The lab shows rank fusion end to end.

features.title: Curated RAG corpus (allowlist)
features.blurb: Ingestion is allowlisted; the corpus stays curated and auditable.

steps.title: Ask a question the curated corpus answers.
steps.prompt: What yield strength should I assume for aluminum 6061-T6?
talking_points: Allowlisted sources only.

steps.title: Confirm the refusal path stays honest.
steps.prompt: What is the tensile strength of unobtainium?
